subject: Unexpected conversation latency — investigation and mitigation steps
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@novussys.com>, Samira Khan <samira.k@novussys.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: [Action] Elevated latency observed on streaming/chat endpoint — Novus Systems

Hi Alex / Samira,

I wanted to let you know we detected elevated end-to-end latency impacting streaming/chat responses for Novus Systems starting ~08:45 PDT this morning. The initial alert shows token delivery delays (pauses of 400–800ms per chunk) for a subset of conversations routed through the us-west edge. Impact: some live chat sessions are experiencing slower partial responses and, in a few cases, timeouts at the application layer.

What were doing now:
- We have diverted new traffic away from the affected edge shard to a healthy shard (short-term mitigation).
- Engineering is collecting detailed traces and a pcap of the affected connections (attached diagnostics).
- Were running a targeted rollforward for a runtime kernel fix to reduce queueing for large-batch requests.

Immediate customer mitigations you can apply (if you want to act locally):
- Switch to the non-streaming generation endpoint (/v1/completions) for high-concurrency users for the next 24–48 hours.
- Reduce client-side max_tokens and lower the concurrency window (preferred: batch_size <= 4).
- Increase request-level timeouts to 60s to avoid premature client-side failures while we stabilize.

Attachments: diagnostic-snippet-20260518.txt (request IDs & timing), edge-trace-20260518.pcap (network capture).

We will update within two hours with a status and an ETA for a full runtime patch. Im pushing this as urgent with the on-call infra team. Do you have a high-priority production flow we should deprioritize traffic for while we work this?

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Also, if this will take more than a couple hours, wed like to discuss a temporary credit for the window of degraded performance. Samira, please prioritize routing adjustments on our side if recommended.

— Alex

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Incident update & post-incident customer guidance — Novus Systems (RS-2158)

Hi Alex / Samira,

Thank you for your patience while we completed the investigation and remediation. Below is a concise summary, impact, and recommended follow-ups.

Summary and root cause (short):
- Root cause: an interdependent queueing condition in a us-west edge shard exacerbated by large batched inference requests (batch_size >= 16) and unusual tokenization patterns. This caused per-chunk dispatch delays (400–800ms) for affected requests.
- Fixes applied: (1) traffic was rerouted off the affected shard within 20 minutes of detection; (2) a targeted runtime kernel adjustment was rolled forward to avoid head-of-line blocking for mixed-length sequences; (3) we deployed an edge-routing policy to prioritize pinned model traffic and avoid inadvertent batching mismatches.

Impact for Novus Systems:
- Time window: May 18, 2026 08:45–09:10 PDT (primary impact), with residual degraded throughput on a small percentage of sessions until 10:20 PDT while traces were analyzed and reroutes completed.
- Symptoms observed: slower incremental responses in streaming mode and occasional application-layer timeouts. No model inference correctness regressions were observed.

Actions you should take (recommended):
- If you require immediate zero-risk behavior: switch affected production flows to the non-streaming /v1/completions endpoint while we complete the full postmortem (we have validated functional parity).
- Temporarily reduce client-side batch sizes to <= 8 for high-concurrency flows.
- Use the attached workaround-config-20260518.pdf for temporary client-side settings that reduce load on large batches.

Compensation & next steps:
- We will apply a one-time service credit for the primary impact window (details forthcoming from Finance & CS).
- Well share the full engineering postmortem and telemetry within 5 business days (RS-2158).
- If youd like a joint technical review (30–45 minutes) to walk through the traces and our mitigations, I can schedule it with Ben and Laura.

Attachments: diagnostic-snippet-20260518.txt, edge-trace-20260518.pcap, workaround-config-20260518.pdf

If you want immediate assistance switching endpoints or applying the workaround-config, I can coordinate directly with your ops team — ping me the convenient window and Ill set it up.

Apologies again for the disruption — we take incidents like this seriously and are incorporating the lessons into our batching heuristics and routing policies.

Best regards,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
On-call escalation: ben_carter@redwood.ai; lead engineer: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
